eligibility.reason: E1/E4: a full launch log and camera format enumeration establish a concrete capture/decode failure. E2 reaches step 6: MJPEG payload chroma layout crosses from the camera to usb_cam, whose fixed YUV422P allocation differs from the decoded picture; the result depends on the camera peer. E3: PAIR. The same log also documents two refused camera-control interactions of this pair, which must be included under S1.

failed_conditions.reason: representation_convention is supported by the decoded 4:2:0 versus assumed 4:2:2 payload layout. However, the camera enumerates MJPG and the node requests mjpeg; there is no demonstrated disagreement in the V4L2 negotiated pixelformat field itself. Attribute the mismatch to the dequeued encoded frame payload, not to that format selector.

missed_conditions.description: Camera control white_balance_temperature_auto is unavailable to the consumer control-setting request.
missed_conditions.reason: usb_cam_node calls set_v4l_parameter for this control during initialization. That function invokes v4l2-ctl against camera_dev_ and forwards its error output. This is a refused interaction with the same camera, not an unrelated calibration-file problem. No removal history is established, so other is preferable to element_removed_or_renamed.

missed_conditions.description: Camera control focus_auto is unavailable to the consumer control-setting request.
missed_conditions.reason: This is a second distinct control refusal during initialization of the same camera-node pair. S1 includes enforced refusals within the selected composition even if they are not the main reported symptom.

loudness.reason: The main per-frame decoder error alone is a runtime check, but the composition also includes the two omitted startup control refusals diagnosed by existing v4l2-ctl tooling. With all required same-composition conditions included, silent_documented is not a defensible aggregate label.

detection_stage.reason: The control-setting calls occur in UsbCamNode construction before its capture loop; this is the earliest documented detection for the full composition. The originally listed MJPEG payload condition is still detected at run, not activate.

resolution.quote: A new parameter `color_format` is introduced with possible values `yuv420p` and `yuv422p`, because some cameras like Mobius Maxi does not support `yuv422p` which is the default.
resolution.reason: Recommended remains the right status for the proposed decoder fix: successful tests identify different cameras, not this camera at a known firmware revision. The color_format fix does not establish resolution of the two added control refusals; those have no demonstrated resolution here.

notes: The specification explicitly excludes the two unknown-control warnings, but S1 requires every documented failed interaction within the selected pair, including enforced refusals. Both are attributable to this pair through inspected node initialization and v4l2-ctl invocation code. They are represented on the existing resource:/dev/video0 inventory entry; the inventory should be expanded if finer-grained control tokens are needed. Missing calibration-file and log-disk-space warnings are outside the selected camera boundary and remain excluded. Main-condition loudness/run and aggregate loudness/activate must not be conflated.
